tools.name: runner_doctor.py - why the queue runner stopped, and start it again
tools.author: Cowork, 2026-08-12
tools.utility: 🔴 THE BACKGROUND LANE HAD NO LIVENESS CHECK AND IT IS THE MOST LOAD-BEARING MONITOR IN THE MESH.
